definitions.name: createLayer
definitions.description: Create a real editable layer; a full-frame background uses kind=solid or rectangle, width/height matching the composition and position at composition center. kind=null is an invisible helper, not a rendered background. Images require an imported asset ID.

position.description: Layer transform position in composition pixels, at the layer anchor/center, not its top-left corner. Default is composition center.

definitions.name: createRectangle
definitions.description: Create an editable rectangle layer.

position.description: Layer transform position in composition pixels, at the layer anchor/center, not its top-left corner. Default is composition center.

definitions.name: createEllipse
definitions.description: Create an editable ellipse layer.

position.description: Layer transform position in composition pixels, at the layer anchor/center, not its top-left corner. Default is composition center.

definitions.name: createPolygon
definitions.description: Create an editable polygon layer.

position.description: Layer transform position in composition pixels, at the layer anchor/center, not its top-left corner. Default is composition center.

definitions.name: createStar
definitions.description: Create an editable star layer.

position.description: Layer transform position in composition pixels, at the layer anchor/center, not its top-left corner. Default is composition center.

definitions.name: createText
definitions.description: Create editable text. content is required; position is {x,y} composition pixels. Optional fontSize, fontFamily, color {r,g,b,a} in 0..1, alignment left/center/right. Defaults to canvas center. Never use text/font_size aliases.

position.description: Layer transform position in composition pixels, at the layer anchor/center, not its top-left corner. Default is composition center.

definitions.name: createPath
definitions.description: Create a closed editable path. points is a flat array of [x,y,inX,inY,outX,outY] per vertex. All six coordinates are ABSOLUTE layer-local pixels, origin at the layer center, NOT handle offsets or composition coordinates. For straight edges repeat the vertex three times: [x,y,x,y,x,y]; zero handles curve toward the origin. Typically vertices span -width/2..width/2 and -height/2..height/2. position places the local origin in the composition.

position.description: Layer transform position in composition pixels, at the layer anchor/center, not its top-left corner. Default is composition center.

definitions.name: deleteLayer
definitions.description: Delete a layer and detach remaining children; requires confirmation.

definitions.name: duplicateLayer
definitions.description: Duplicate a layer with fresh entity IDs.

definitions.name: renameLayer
definitions.description: Rename editable layer.

definitions.name: reorderLayer
definitions.description: Move layer to a zero-based stack index.

definitions.name: setLayerVisibility
definitions.description: Set actual visibility.

definitions.name: setParent
definitions.description: Reuse shared parent transform compensation.

definitions.name: createPrecomp
definitions.description: Precompose related selected layers through shared commands.

definitions.name: setPosition
definitions.description: Set position at current/explicit timeline time.

definitions.name: setAnchor
definitions.description: Set anchor at current/explicit timeline time.

definitions.name: setOpacity
definitions.description: Set opacity at current/explicit timeline time.

definitions.name: setScale
definitions.description: Set absolute local scale with shared pivot compensation.

definitions.name: setRotation
definitions.description: Set absolute rotation with shared pivot compensation.

definitions.name: transformSelection
definitions.description: Relative group/individual transform. Factor 1.2 means 120%; use selection-center for a shared center.

definitions.name: setTransformPivot
definitions.description: Set workspace pivot for subsequent transforms; never modifies layer anchor.

definitions.name: setTransformOrientation
definitions.description: Set workspace orientation for subsequent transforms.

definitions.name: setFill
definitions.description: Set native animated shape/solid/text fill. Optional gradient none/linear/radial changes the existing fill mode, preserving shape alpha and geometry. linear uses color and endColor. radial uses radialParameters with exact registered radialGradient parameter IDs (normalized center, radius, flat stops). Native fill does NOT require createNode or graph wiring; existing downstream blur processes it.

definitions.name: setStroke
definitions.description: Set actual stroke color and width.

definitions.name: setTextContent
definitions.description: Replace editable text content.

definitions.name: setFont
definitions.description: Set font family name; cannot read fonts from disk.

definitions.name: setFontSize
definitions.description: Set text fontSize through animated property.

definitions.name: setTracking
definitions.description: Set text tracking through animated property.

definitions.name: setLeading
definitions.description: Set text lineHeight through animated property.

definitions.name: setTextColor
definitions.description: Set text fill color.

definitions.name: setTextAlignment
definitions.description: Set text alignment without changing glyph data.

definitions.name: addEffect
definitions.description: Insert an existing effect into the actual compositing graph.

definitions.name: removeEffect
definitions.description: Remove effect node; requires confirmation.

definitions.name: setEffectParameter
definitions.description: Set animated parameter of an existing effect node.

definitions.name: enableEffect
definitions.description: Toggle an actual effect node.

definitions.name: reorderEffect
definitions.description: Reorder a linear effect stack; branched graphs are rejected.

definitions.name: addKeyframe
definitions.description: Add a real timeline keyframe. Use propertyId, or layerId + property path (position/scale/rotation/opacity or editor.properties key), including layers created earlier in the same plan.

definitions.name: deleteKeyframe
definitions.description: Delete a timeline keyframe.

definitions.name: moveKeyframe
definitions.description: Move a timeline keyframe in seconds.

definitions.name: setKeyframeValue
definitions.description: Change actual keyframe value.

definitions.name: setInterpolation
definitions.description: Set interpolation and clear stale outgoing handles.

definitions.name: applyMotionCurve
definitions.description: Apply normalized motion curve to actual adjacent keyframe segments.

definitions.name: copyEasing
definitions.description: Copy a normalized segment curve to other segments.

definitions.name: reverseEasing
definitions.description: Reverse timing and progress of normalized curves.

definitions.name: compileGraph
definitions.description: 调用共享合成图服务：compileGraph

definitions.name: createNode
definitions.description: Create a registered graph node. Image processors with in/out ports automatically insert into the current Output edge. Generators without an input remain detached. For generator -> effect -> Output, call setGraphOutput on the generator BEFORE creating the effect; do not connect an already occupied effect input again. Position changes layout, not insertion behavior.

edgeId.description: Optional EXISTING edge ID read from this graph. Omit to insert before the current Output; never generate or guess an edgeId.

definitions.name: deleteNode
definitions.description: 调用共享合成图服务：deleteNode

definitions.name: connectNodes
definitions.description: Connect exact typed ports. Inputs accept only one edge; inspect and disconnect any existing edge first. Never add duplicate connections.

definitions.name: disconnectEdge
definitions.description: 调用共享合成图服务：disconnectEdge

definitions.name: setNodeParameter
definitions.description: 调用共享合成图服务：setNodeParameter

definitions.name: setNodePosition
definitions.description: 调用共享合成图服务：setNodePosition

definitions.name: enableNode
definitions.description: 调用共享合成图服务：enableNode

definitions.name: createMask
definitions.description: 创建现有可渲染图层遮罩；路径每个点为 x,y,inX,inY,outX,outY

definitions.name: setMaskMode
definitions.description: 设置遮罩叠加、减去或相交模式

definitions.name: setMaskPath
definitions.description: 通过共享属性命令修改遮罩 path

definitions.name: setMaskFeather
definitions.description: 通过共享属性命令修改遮罩 feather

definitions.name: setMaskOpacity
definitions.description: 通过共享属性命令修改遮罩 opacity

definitions.name: setMaskExpansion
definitions.description: 通过共享属性命令修改遮罩 expansion

definitions.name: createComposition
definitions.description: 创建空合成

definitions.name: setCompositionSize
definitions.description: 修改合成尺寸

definitions.name: setDuration
definitions.description: 修改合成 duration

definitions.name: setFPS
definitions.description: 修改合成 fps

definitions.name: openComposition
definitions.description: 切换当前合成

definitions.name: deleteComposition
definitions.description: 删除合成，需要确认；拒绝当前、最后一个及被引用合成

definitions.name: createLayerFromAsset
definitions.description: 仅使用已导入图像素材创建图层

definitions.name: replaceAssetReference
definitions.description: 替换图像图层的已授权素材引用

definitions.name: inspectProject
definitions.description: Read project metadata and composition index; no filesystem or asset bodies.

definitions.name: inspectComposition
definitions.description: Read composition dimensions, timing and bounded layer summary.

definitions.name: listLayers
definitions.description: List a page of layers with stable IDs.

definitions.name: inspectLayer
definitions.description: Read selected layer properties, keyframes, graph summary and bounds.

definitions.name: inspectSelection
definitions.description: Read the current selection and active composition.

definitions.name: inspectProperty
definitions.description: Read property value and animated state by stable ID.

definitions.name: inspectKeyframes
definitions.description: Read a page of actual persisted keyframes.

definitions.name: inspectEffects
definitions.description: Read effect node identities and actual parameters.

definitions.name: inspectGraph
definitions.description: Read graph nodes, edges and parameters without mutation.

definitions.name: inspectAssets
definitions.description: Read imported asset metadata only. Never disk paths or embedded data.

definitions.name: getCurrentTime
definitions.description: Read current timeline time in seconds.

definitions.name: getCanvasInfo
definitions.description: Read composition canvas size and active camera.
